title: GEI Research Reproducibility Baseline Protocol
objective: Define a repeatable, auditable procedure for independently rerunning the current Genesis 1 research investigation without changing its inputs, mappings, or epistemic status during execution.

protocol_steps.action: Freeze and identify the protocol version, investigation, source records, evidence records, comparison records, interpretation, and hypothesis under test.
protocol_steps.expected_observation: All required record identifiers resolve to canonical records and versions before execution.
protocol_steps.acceptance_rule: No unresolved required input may be used.

protocol_steps.action: Reconstruct the investigation inputs from the canonical repository and preserve the stated passage, source, evidence, comparison, and alternative-explanation selections.
protocol_steps.expected_observation: A second operator can reconstruct the same declared input set.
protocol_steps.acceptance_rule: Input identifiers and versions match the protocol baseline.

protocol_steps.action: Execute the documented passage-level textual, lexical, comparative, historical-context, and counterevidence checks without adding post-hoc mappings.
protocol_steps.expected_observation: Each test step produces a recorded observation or an explicit not-run/deviation state.
protocol_steps.acceptance_rule: Deviations are recorded rather than silently corrected.

protocol_steps.action: Compare observed results with the predefined predictions and with the stated non-hydraulic alternative explanations.
protocol_steps.acceptance_rule: A mismatch cannot be relabeled as support without recorded evidence.

protocol_steps.action: Record the reproduction run, step outcomes, evidence links, deviations, limitations, and resulting reproducibility status.
protocol_steps.expected_observation: Another researcher can audit the reproduction record independently.
protocol_steps.acceptance_rule: Reproducibility status is determined from recorded execution, not from connectivity alone.

inputs.description: Genesis 1 source record used by the investigation.
Water-technology source record used for contextual comparison.
Investigation and hypothesis records under test.

reproducibility_criteria.name: Input fidelity
reproducibility_criteria.rule: All required declared inputs resolve to the same canonical records and versions.

reproducibility_criteria.name: Protocol fidelity
reproducibility_criteria.rule: All protocol steps are executed or explicitly marked not_run with deviations recorded.

reproducibility_criteria.name: Observation traceability
reproducibility_criteria.rule: Observed claims are linked to recorded observations or evidence.

reproducibility_criteria.name: Alternative-explanation control
reproducibility_criteria.rule: Results are compared against predefined non-hydraulic alternatives.

controls: Do not upgrade hypothesis status from reproducibility alone
alternative_explanations: Symbolic literary ordering without engineering referent
epistemic_firewall: This protocol evaluates whether a research procedure can be reproduced. Reproducibility does not establish truth, authorial intent, or confirmation of the GEI hypothesis. CONNECTED ≠ SUPPORTED ≠ CORROBORATED ≠ CONFIRMED.
notes: Baseline protocol for V1.0.15. Future protocol revisions require a new version and provenance record rather than silent replacement.
